description: A script for running tests with Xvfb on Linux and normally on other platforms, managing virtual X server processes, environment setup, and execution flow.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills a process by PID, ignoring errors if the process no longer exists.

methods.name: get_xvfb_path
methods.description: Determines the path to the Xvfb executable based on server directory and architecture.

methods.name: start_xvfb
methods.description: Starts a virtual X server using Xvfb and returns its process ID.

methods.name: wait_for_xvfb
methods.description: Waits for Xvfb to initialize properly by checking with xdisplaycheck.

methods.name: run_executable
methods.description: Runs a command within an Xvfb buffer on Linux or normally on other platforms, handling environment setup and process management.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and executes the test command accordingly.
